description.p: LiveDeck is an unofficial Twitch client made for a TV and a controller, such as SteamOS Game Mode on the Steam Deck. Browse live streams and categories, watch with read-only chat, and sign in with a code to see who you follow.
LiveDeck is not affiliated with Twitch or Valve. Streams are found with Streamlink through unofficial endpoints, which can break and may conflict with Twitch's terms of service.
